scope: Hold timing only. Production changes are ShapeCompletion.swift and DrawingSession.swift; shape fitting, UI, rendering/eraser engine, file format and other product code unchanged.

nativeHeldObservation.input: Real XCUITest touch in isolated app; not physical Apple Pencil
nativeHeldObservation.conclusion: Do not assume drawing.strokes.last is the active stroke.

behavior.timer: Cancellable monotonic deadline; pending wakeup re-evaluates anchor, no per-frame polling or per-move task allocation
behavior.preview: Actual/coalesced current-contact points, existing fitter, transparent viewport-sized native ink image; hides native ink layer atomically without covering PDF. Native drawing and native drawing gesture are untouched while contact is active.
behavior.commit: After contact/native end and known estimated updates: reuse native brush/point attributes, trim post-snap tail, one existing undoable replacement. Render-finished handoff; matching late native source repaired without an extra undo entry.
behavior.cancellation: Invalidate generations on lift before snap, cancellation, tool/page change, app inactivity. Cancellation retains native ink.
